en.text:
Anticipation passively charges over 160 seconds. Dealing damage with other weapons drastically reduces the charge rate based on damage dealt, which at its fastest reaches 100% charge in 3 seconds. 

Firing (not holding down the trigger, despite what the UI shows) consumes the meter.

The time required to fully charge Whirling Ovation's rocket is reduced to 4.25|3.75|3.15|2.5|2 seconds at 20%|40%|60%|80|100% Anticipation.
